content.value: A reflex Klystron operates under the following conditions:
The tube is oscillating at f<sub>r</sub> at the peak of the n = 2 or $1 \%$ mode. Assume that the transit time through the gap and beam loading can be neglected.
(i) Find the value of the repeller voltage $\mathrm { V _ { r } } .$
(ii) Find the direct current necessary to give a microwave gap voltage of 200 V.
(iii) What is the electronic efficiency under this condition?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
